usage: icebath proxy [-h] {start,status,providers} ...

Run a local HTTP server that forwards OpenAI-compatible requests to an OAuth-authenticated
provider (e.g. Nous Portal). External apps can point at the proxy with any bearer token; the proxy
attaches your real credentials.

positional arguments:
  {start,status,providers}
    start               Run the proxy in the foreground
    status              Show which proxy upstreams are ready
    providers           List available proxy upstream providers

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
